verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. Of David. O YHWH, my heart is not lifted high, and my eyes are not raised up, and neither have I gone about in great things, and in marvelous things beyond me.

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. Of David. O YHWH, my heart is not lifted high, and my eyes are not raised up, and neither have I gone about in great things, and in marvelous things beyond me.

verses.text: If not, I have stilled and quieted my soul like a weaned child with his mother; my soul [is] like a weaned child within me.

segments.text: If not, I have stilled and quieted my soul like a weaned child with his mother; my soul [is] like a weaned child within me.

verses.text: Look with hope, O Israel, unto YHWH, from now even to forever!

segments.text: Look with hope, O Israel, unto YHWH, from now even to forever!
